data.body: ROOT-CAUSE LEAD (from acouchi's landing, 2026-08-13): the xdist teardown flake reproduces LOCALLY under host CPU/memory contention — two full-suite runs died in xdist teardown with 'OSError: cannot send (already closed?)' across all three workers and no summary line while five sibling implementer suites ran concurrently (load ~27); a detached re-run at low load passed clean. harrier's landing saw the same signature as post-results noise (PluggyTeardownRaisedWarning + OSError at teardown, exit 0). So: load-dependent worker-channel teardown race, reproducible by running the suite under artificial CPU pressure — a usable deterministic repro path for this ticket.
